dataformat.name: ical
dataformat.title: iCal
dataformat.description: Marshal and unmarshal iCal (*.ics) documents to/from model objects
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: An ical4j Calendar, such as unmarshal gives. Text is not parsed: unmarshal the iCalendar text first

marshalOut.description: The iCalendar text in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: An iCalendar (.ics) document, which ical4j reads as UTF-8

unmarshalOut.description: An ical4j Calendar of the document

validating.description: Whether to validate the iCal document.
